description: Fast, local Markdown table editing for Visual Studio Code.
workspaceTrust.description: The extension only rewrites Markdown tables in the open editor and never executes workspace content.
command.toggleLightAutoAlign: Toggle Light Auto Align After Edit
setting.lightAutoAlign: Align a table shortly after it is edited.
setting.powerAutoFit: Fit edited tables to the configured width. Also enables light auto align.
setting.fitWidth: Maximum table display width used by fit commands.
